scientific_integrity: Exact formal-power-series proof; reproducible exact-arithmetic and finite exhaustive checker bundled. No independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Complete multipartite named parameter bases of exactly r>=2 nonempty shores in Henson H_(r+1) only; full grade polynomial is known and not new; 3r-2 bound not generally optimal; tripartite grade-five is sharp; first collision finite; prior-coverage comparisons nonexhaustive; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Finite-jet reconstruction of complete multipartite Henson type spectra and the sharp tripartite threshold
